name: Progress MS-18
about: Progress MS-18 (2021-098A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2021 Oct 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2021 Oct 29), held fixed
docked to S26400; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
